scene.ko: 출장으로 일주일 집을 비우게 되어 옆집 이웃에게 택배를 맡아 달라고 부탁하고 연락처를 주고받는다.

lines.en: Hi, Mark. Sorry to bother you. Do you have a minute?
lines.ko: 안녕하세요, 마크 씨. 귀찮게 해서 미안한데요. 잠깐 시간 있어요?
alt: Hi, Mark. Have you got a minute?
Hi, Mark. Sorry to bother you. Are you busy right now?

lines.en: I'm going on a business trip next week, and I'm expecting a package. Could you hold on to it for me?
lines.ko: 다음 주에 출장을 가는데 택배가 하나 올 거예요. 대신 좀 맡아 주실 수 있을까요?
alt: I'll be away on a work trip next week, and a package is coming. Could you keep it for me?
I'm away next week for work, and I'm getting a delivery. Would you mind holding it for me?

lines.en: Probably on Tuesday. I'll ask the delivery driver to leave it at your door.
lines.ko: 아마 화요일일 거예요. 택배 기사님께 마크 씨네 문 앞에 두라고 할게요.
alt: Maybe Tuesday. I'll have them leave it at your door.
Tuesday, I think. I'll tell the driver to leave it by your door.

lines.en: Sounds good. Do you want my number, just in case?
lines.ko: 좋아요. 혹시 모르니까 제 번호 드릴까요?

lines.en: Yes, that would be great. I'll text you so you have mine, too.
lines.ko: 네, 좋아요. 제가 문자 보낼 테니 제 번호도 저장해 두세요.
alt: Yes, please. I'll send you a text so you have my number.
That would be great. Let me text you, so you have mine, too.

lines.en: Got it. Have a safe trip!
Thanks so much. I owe you one.
alt: Thank you so much. I owe you.
Thanks a lot. I really appreciate it.

expressions.en: Sorry to bother you. Do you have a minute?
expressions.ko: 귀찮게 해서 미안한데요. 잠깐 시간 있어요?

expressions.en: Could you hold on to ___ for me?
expressions.note: hold on to = 잠시 맡아 두다
